_comment: Hand-authored sim mechanics for the Ranger (same schema as the Sorcerer mechanics.json). Every Num carries confidence. Extra keys (resources, stat_effects, passive_stats, procs) are extensions the loader ignores; elements may be "wind", which the Element Literal in models.py lacks.

tick_ratio_pct.source: DERIVED, not published (Metaroad shows a dash). Client flat tick (se_abe_dmg ...:tick) is exactly 0.50x the Griffon Arrow hit flat at ranks 1/10/20/40 (482/964, 985/1971, 1351/2702, 2056/4112), so tick ratio = 0.50 x 171% = 85.5% ATK. Assumes the DoT shares the hit's ratio:flat proportion; the flat part is not carried (Status holds a ratio only) and the ratio is rank-independent here, so high ranks are understated

snipe.note: basic chain 1/3 (community name Rapid Shot chain), restores 120 MP at rank 1 (text); spec rank 8 +20% MP restored. Chain order is inferred from guides, window 3.0 s is the shared default, not measured

spiral-arrow.note: chain 3/3, restores 150 MP; Tempest Arrow follows only once Snipe spec rank 16 is taken (client spec text)

tempest-arrow.note: chain 4/4 (needs Snipe spec rank 16), restores 180 MP (text)

marking-shot.note: grants Precision 10 s (+5s with spec rank 8); moves the caster in the input direction; spec rank 12 +1 consecutive use (two casts back to back); costs 50 MP, cd 10 s. Cast standing still, recast with ~2-3 s left (Inven/couga)

deadshot.note: charged skill, 3 charge levels (client text). +35% damage if Precision is active (stat_effects). Charge time per level unknown. Spec rank 8 can remove MP cost

drill-dart.note: Bleed 6 s; restores 100 MP only on landing a Critical Hit (text), so mp_restore is an upper bound; spec rank 16 casts twice

griffon-arrow.note: Crimson Flames 10 s DoT (client text); opens the Griffon macro line

gale-arrow.note: Gale buff 10 s; cooldown 20 s, -10s with spec rank 16

snare-shot.note: Slow 5 s on up to 4 targets; chains into Shackling Arrow only with spec rank 12

shackling-arrow.note: Root 3 s, 75% on players, 100% on NPC (NPC targets 100% per skill text; players lower); KR/TW-only list on aion2hub but named as Snare Shot chain in client spec text

burst-arrow.note: needs a Slowed or Rooted target (client text). Root also satisfies it; the engine has no OR, see requires_any

explosive-arrow-14360000.note: stigma Explosive Arrow: +20% damage to Slowed or Rooted targets at base (text), spec rank 10 +10%, rank 20 +20% more; cooldown 45 s, -15s with spec rank 5. Conditional bonus not expressible as status requirement

suppressing-arrow.note: Stun 3 s; 40% while Precision is active on players; NPC targets 100% per skill text; players lower

explosion-trap.note: trap lasts 10 s, Stun 3 s 40% on players, NPC targets 100% per skill text; players lower; spec rank 8 pulls enemies

ensnaring-trap.note: trap lasts 30 s, Airborne 3 s; spec rank 5 adds Guerilla Strike chain

arrow-storm.note: Stun 3 s, 50% on players, NPC targets 100% per skill text; players lower

assault-smite.note: Stun 3 s, 30% on players, NPC targets 100% per skill text; players lower; spec rank 5 +20% Attack 5 s on hit

lightning-arrow.note: Stun 3 s; chain child of Defiance (spec rank 8); cooldown falls 120 s to 42 s with rank

sealing-arrow.note: Seal 5 s, 75% on players, NPC targets 100% per skill text; players lower

dust-arrow.note: Blind 5 s at 75% (text); reduces 20 Stagger Points; KR/TW only

vaizels-authority.note: cd 60 s; stigma, best at rank 20 first (couga/Whelps). Spec rank 20: 50% chance on crit to cut all cooldowns 1 s (1 s internal cooldown)

supporting-fire.note: cd 90 s (-30s with spec rank 15); shares a button with Vaizel in the couga build

defiance.note: cleanse + Tenacity 5 s; unaffected by cooldown reduction; cooldown falls 60 s to 21 s with rank

stealth.note: cd 120 s at rank 1 falling 3 s per rank (rank 20 = 63 s, rank 40 = 3 s per client)

mother-natures-breath.note: cd 90 s falling 2 s per rank to 12 s

arrow-scattershot.note: usable only on a Staggered target (text); 4 hits; spec rank 8 restores 120 MP on hit; stagger is not a status in this model

tempest-shot.note: filler, costs 120 MP (spec rank 8 -20%), 2 hits, 4 targets

mp.note: MP is the constraint on long fights (GEGEBASE, Inven threads). Restores: Snipe 120, Rapid Fire 120, Spiral Arrow 150, Tempest Arrow 180 (rank 1 text, rank scaling unknown), Drill Dart 100 on crit, Arrow Scattershot spec 120. Spenders: Tempest Shot 120, Deadshot 200 (spec 8 removes), Gale Arrow 200, Snare Shot 150, Marking Shot 50. Natural regen and pool size are not in any source.

stamina.note: Defiance spec rank 8 restores 1000 Stamina; Wind Vigor raises Max Stamina; Sealing Arrow spec 10 drains 1000 enemy Stamina. No stamina costs found.

cooldown_reduction.note: Snipe spec 12: -1s Deadshot cooldown on hit; Arrow Scattershot spec 16: -1s all cooldowns on hit; Vaizel spec 20: 50% chance -1s all cooldowns on crit (1 s ICD); Burst Arrow spec 16 and Suppressing Arrow spec 16: 25% chance to reset cooldown on hit; Explosive Arrow spec 20 text -50% own cooldown vs Slow/Root.

korea_only_note: Eye of Rapid Burst, Afterimage, Hunters Resolve_active, Arrow of Space-time, Dust Arrow, Impact Kick: no unlock level, no stigma, listed only on the KR/TW client v110 (aion2hub 12-skill KR/TW list). Without this gate the optimizer cast them for free damage. Rapid Fire/Spiral Arrow/Tempest Arrow/Shackling Arrow/Guerilla Strike/Lightning Arrow stay global: community guides use the Snipe chain on global content and they are chain children.

deferred_triggers.note: Melee Fire: 25% per landed attack (token abe:1478000012:value02:divide100 = 25), 26.4% ATK + 148 flat, Cooldown 1s; evaluated once per cast, the proc skill's own 1 s cooldown caps it. DEFERRED (not in 'triggers'): enabling it adds ~7 s (+45%) to optimize_full_build boss at level 45, which already sits near the 30 s limit under load. Move it into 'triggers' when the simulator gets cheaper (about +4% DPS).
